end.summary: Discussed how earthworms and other soil animals help soil.
end.parentNote: Asha practised that earthworm tunnels let air and water into soil and that soil animals help turn dead leaves into rich soil. Pihu identified ants and described seeing a black, shiny beetle with a hard back and small legs in soil. Pihu repeatedly said earthworms harm soil and eat crop roots; this mix-up was not corrected by the end. At home, look at a picture or safe soil sample together and sort statements into “helps soil” and “harms crops.”
